title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) 2027
level: Master's applicants from developing countries (see official guidelines)
about: The World Bank's Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program 2027 is for developing-country nationals applying to listed development-related master's programmes. Window 1 runs from 18 January to 26 February 2027; Window 2 runs from 29 March to 21 May 2027.
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for "Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) 2027" at World Bank, application deadline 26 Feb 2027. The background photo shows an aerial view of a city skyline with a tall tower beside a winding river at sunset.
